        <tr><td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">2</span></td><td><b>What holds regardless of model</b></td><td class="prior">&ldquo;Context is a scarce resource that degrades under load&rdquo;<span class="prior-src">ch01 L43-47</span></td><td class="prior">&ldquo;What isn't in the context window doesn't exist for the agent&rdquo;<span class="prior-src">ch01 L43-47</span></td><td class="prior">&ldquo;Determinism comes from constraints, structure, and grounding, not from the model itself&rdquo;<span class="prior-src">ch01 L43-47</span></td></tr>

    Context windows have grown roughly 100&ndash;1,000&times; in five years, from GPT-3&rsquo;s 2,048 tokens in 2020 to the

    tasks has not kept pace<sup>2</sup>. (ch01 L49)<br>
    <span style="font-size:6.8pt"><sup>1</sup> GPT-3 supported 2,048 tokens (Brown et al., 2020). GPT-4 Turbo expanded to 128K tokens (OpenAI DevDay, November 2023). Gemini 1.5 Pro reached 1M tokens (Google, February 2024). Claude 3 launched with 200K tokens (Anthropic, March 2024).
    <sup>2</sup> In the 2024 Stack Overflow Developer Survey, 45% of professional developers rated AI tools as &ldquo;bad&rdquo; or &ldquo;very bad&rdquo; at handling complex tasks, even as overall AI adoption reached 76%. See survey.stackoverflow.co/2024/ai. (ch01 footnotes)</span>
